set.body: From the S5.5 geometry review. Studio's geometry panel shows per-trial placement (thumbnails, worked example) for DRAFT revisions, which the backend cannot yet evaluate; S5.5 therefore re-derives placement from eyes4s primitives (a second implementation of MapPlacement without DroppedInitial) and labels it 'preview of rN (not admitted)'. Ask: a backend preview for a draft DatasetRevisionSpec — StudyPreview.windowTallies and CoordinateTrail per trial (with MapPlacement incl. DroppedInitial) — over the draft's geometry, corrections and OffScreenPolicy, without admitting it; exposed through StudyBackend so S3.7 can replace Studio's parallel path.
set.title: Backend draft preview: window tallies and coordinate trails for an unadmitted dataset revision
